paragraphs: Tek84 makes X-ray body scanners that look for contraband hidden on or inside a person. The company says its customers include correctional facilities, government agencies, airports, military organizations, and critical infrastructure operators.

Its argument rests on the limits of older screening, since metal detectors and pat searches often miss non-metallic or internally concealed items. The scanners produce high resolution images showing both metallic and non-metallic threats in seconds, so an operator can decide quickly. The settings the company names include airports, borders, and prisons.

Tek84 says it designs, engineers, manufactures, trains, and supports its systems entirely in the United States. It ties that to federal domestic procurement rules, saying its systems align with Buy America requirements. The site lists upcoming conferences and trade shows where the company plans to exhibit. A copyright notice on the page runs from 2018 under the name Tek84, Inc.
